headline: H100 SXM and H200 rental prices fell over the week while B200, MI300X, A100 and L40S held flat.
bullets: H100 SXM led the declines with a 7-day change of -19%, bringing its market index to $4.32 across 12 providers.
H200 dropped -14% over 7 days to a $5.40 market index, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $3.59.
MI300X offers the best price-performance at $3.62 per PFLOP-hour, ahead of B200 at $3.78, with a neocloud median of $2.92 versus $6.75 at hyperscalers.
Hyperscaler premiums remain steep, widest for H100 SXM at +162% ($10.68 versus $4.07 neocloud) and narrowest for B200 at +77%.
B200 held flat (+0%) at an $8.50 market index, with RunPod Community Cloud the cheapest provider at $5.98.
watch: Watch whether the H100 SXM and H200 declines spread to the hyperscaler segment, where medians of $10.68 and $10.30 still sit far above neocloud pricing.
